component.name: MainScene
component.script:
function init() m.iptvPlayer = m.top.findNode("iptvPlayer") ' M3U URL with credentials m.m3uUrl = "http://ns106911.ip-51-81-106.us:25461/get.php?username=twainbrooks34@gmail.com&password=jetstream1&type=m3u_plus"
' Load M3U playlist on startup loadM3uPlaylist(m.m3uUrl) end function
function loadM3uPlaylist(url as String) as void print "Loading M3U from: " + url http = createObject("roUrlTransfer") http.setUrl(url) http.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") http.setConnectTimeout(15) http.setReadTimeout(30) http.addHeader("User-Agent", "Roku/9.0")
response = http.getToString() if response <> invalid and response <> "" print "M3U loaded successfully, parsing..." parseAndPlayM3u(response) else print "Failed to load M3U playlist" m.iptvPlayer.showError("Failed to load M3U playlist") end if end function
function parseAndPlayM3u(m3uContent as String) as void lines = m3uContent.split(chr(10)) channels = [] currentChannel = invalid
for each line in lines line = line.trim() if line <> "" if line.left(8) = "#EXTINF:" ' Parse channel info currentChannel = { title: extractChannelName(line), url: "" } else if line.left(1) <> "#" and currentChannel <> invalid ' This is the URL for the current channel currentChannel.url = line channels.push(currentChannel) currentChannel = invalid end if end if end for
print "Parsed " + stri(channels.count()) + " channels"
if channels.count() > 0 m.iptvPlayer.loadChannels(channels) m.iptvPlayer.playChannel(0) else print "No channels found in M3U" m.iptvPlayer.showError("No channels found in M3U playlist") end if end function
function extractChannelName(extinf as String) as String ' Parse #EXTINF:-1, Channel Name comma = extinf.instr(",") if comma > 0 name = extinf.mid(comma + 1, extinf.len() - comma - 1).trim() return if(name <> "", name, "Unknown Channel") else return "Unknown Channel" end if end function
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false return m.iptvPlayer.onKeyEvent(key, press) end function
